Hi Samir —

We missed you on the drop-in a few minutes ago and I dropped by the meeting room but it looks like something came up. Quick note with a couple of triage steps in case you want to unblock before we rebook:

Quick triage (3 mins):
- Confirm your API key: env var REDWOOD_API_KEY set and no leading/trailing whitespace.
- Try a curl health call: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
- If you see 401, TTL may have expired or the key was rotated.
- Check outbound firewall rules (ports 443) and any corporate proxy that rewrites headers.

If you prefer to reschedule, I can open any 30-minute slot next week:
- Wed 2026-12-16 10:00–10:30 PST
- Thu 2026-12-17 14:00–14:30 PST
- Mon 2026-12-21 09:00–09:30 PST

If none of those work, send me two times that suit your timezone and we’ll lock one. I also attached the Azure checklist since I remember Fintra is running an AKS cluster — that doc has the common IP/network items that trip folks up.

Hi Samir —

No worries — thanks for the heads up. I just generated a temporary trial key for Fintra that will expire in 48 hours. Please treat it as short-lived: do not check it into source control and rotate after the session.

Temporary trial key (expires in 48h): temp_trial_abc123xyz
(Attached as a text file for your convenience: temp-trial-key.txt)

Quick SDK steps (Python) to validate from your environment:
1) pip install redwood-inference
2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=temp_trial_abc123xyz
3) python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client(); print(c.generate(\"Hello\"))"

If you still see 401 after exporting the key, please: check that the process/container picked up the env var, and ensure any corporate proxy isn't stripping Authorization headers. If you want, book a 30-min slot with me (link below) and I’ll join with remote SSH if you need it. Otherwise, Olga can lock Thu 12/17 14:00 PST on her calendar.
